role: Declares the ghast lane's API from ghasts.c: the probe player and world structs, the ghast construct/AI/damage/drop functions, the fireball impact and NBT, the natural spawn and the probe's tick pass with its removal record.

structs.name: gh_player
structs.java: a bare EntityPlayer: entityId, UUID, rand, posX/Y/Z, motionX/Y/Z, rotationYaw/Pitch, health, prevHealth, absorption, hurtTime, maxHurtTime, deathTime, hurtResistantTime, lastDamage, entityAge, isDead, velocityChanged

structs.name: gh_removal
structs.java: the oracle GhastProbe removal row, not a vanilla class

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 28, struct gh_world: holds a pointer to the an_world (pointer graph)
notes: living_dmg_unblockable is declared here but defined elsewhere (living.c per its comment); not verified which file defines it.
